findings.summary: Rig recorded win=true although the run ended on the LOSS overlay: trace t=83.8 shows resultText='TRY AGAIN' with sub-text 'Fell in the dungeon — the monsters got you!' and mazeDeaths=3, yet gates.win=true (any #screen-result.active passes; _looks_like_win's loss verdict only lands in verdictNote), so this maze's failure to reach the win path also passed the gate.

The ?ap=1 autopilot never reached the win path in 3/3 observed runs (rig run + 2 manual ?debugMaze=1 probe attempts): it lost all 3 in-level lives while stalling deterministically at exactly facts=98/136 (all six probe deaths recorded with facts=98; the rig run froze at 98/136 for its final 23s), dying at the tunnel-row corners (rig stills: bottom-right at t=32.9 and t=58.6, bottom-left at t=82.1) because maze.js's bot evade/threat-shadow math is raw Manhattan distance with no wrap handling; note the remix also drops data.lives so the dungeon defaults to 3 lives vs the original's 4.

Same HUD collision as the studyhall but worse: the 60-char title line ('LOUIS-PHILIPPE-GAULIN-KNIGHT-S-DUNGEON-SCRAMBLE · KNIGHT'S…') overruns the left slot and is overprinted by the centered GLORY/FACTS counter.

Harness parity gap: window.__TEST_API__.snapshot() in maze.js omits the 'player' field that maze-studyhall.js exposes, so dungeon probes/rigs get no player position (every manual dungeon death log read player={fx:null,fy:null} from snapshot at t=33.8/48.2/60.3).

Controls hint is English-only and its shared maze-genre copy says 'school facts' in this medieval dungeon ('← ↑ → ↓ / WASD steer · clear the maze (school facts / dungeon loot)'), with no FR text and no controls string in level.json for the booth's FR signage.
still-error.png was planted by the two known booth-logo 404s (assets/logo-all.svg + logo-in.svg missing but referenced), not by any app error — same misleading error-still as the studyhall run.
